thread_geometry: Simplified female and male M2 major envelopes without helical thread flanks; the assembled female bore is not the drill diameter.
machining_callout: Drill diameter 1.6 to full cylindrical depth 6.0 from X13.15 (floor X7.15), with a 118-degree drill point beyond. Chamfer mouth to diameter 2.4: actual chamfer extends 0.4 mm to X12.75. Tap M2 x 0.4 with at least 4.0 mm full thread AFTER that actual chamfer (X12.75 to X8.75); allow no more than 1.2 mm tap runout toward X7.55. The simplified major-diameter CAD exposes only 0.2 mm of this chamfer and must NOT be used to infer full thread length. Nominal overlap with the screw is 2.8 mm before allowance for the screw tip's incomplete threads. Pilot-only STEP is an operation blank, never a finished assembly part.

interpretation.pin_rotation: Passive floating pin with a head screwdriver slot; pin rotation and friction are not solved.
interpretation.body_assignment: Pin, keeper washer and retaining screw use the original pin parent body as a neutral placement and centreline-motion reference, not a dynamic spin constraint.
interpretation.fastener_reference: Nominal DIN 9021 M2 washer and DIN 912 M2x4 socket-head screw envelopes; source_docs must be present and hash-bound before construction.
interpretation.density: All three new/modified metal parts use the v1 steel assumption 7.85e-6 kg/mm3, not measured A2 hardware density or weight.
interpretation.axial_retention: Screw clamps the keeper washer against the pin end. Locking method, preload, thread strip strength, tool access and actual endplay require separate validation.
interpretation.outer_envelopes: Zero-travel pin envelope fills only the screwdriver slot, retaining its female-hole void. Travelled pin envelope fills voids conservatively. Screw envelope fills its socket. These are nominal geometric clearance envelopes, not thread-insertion simulation.
interpretation.unchanged_design: The manufacturing_v1 joint frames, lengths, exterior and exploratory thumb IP range are retained; no new physical travel approval.
